text: Binary: from OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP, parsed), returns 1 if at least one comment gives a concrete, locally verifiable example as its own support: a specific instance, case, data point, or personal experience with concrete particulars a reader could check or observe directly (not a general principle or invented hypothetical; external verification not required). Quoted text from others counts only if the commenter uses it as their own supporting example. Returns 0 if the list is non-empty but no comment qualifies, and 0 for an empty list; null if OC_comments is missing or malformed. List order is ignored. Excludes OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and text reporting whether the outcome occurred (generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not excluded and stays eligible); delta is not used.
